item.title: D-Robotics and GigaAI Pair GigaBrain-0.7 With Sunrise S600 Edge Stack
item.description: D-Robotics and GigaAI will adapt open-source embodied model GigaBrain-0.7 for the Sunrise S600 edge platform at 560 TOPS INT8, linking GigaWorld and policy stacks for Maker, light-pickup, dual-arm and mobile-chassis deployments.

item.title: Huawei Ascend CANN Open-Source Community Claims China-Leading Activity
item.description: Huawei says its Ascend CANN open-source community now tops 6,230 monthly active developers and 60 million-plus repository downloads, with more than half of active contributions coming from outside Ascend and Day-0 open source for Ascend 950.

item.title: ByteDance Ties Doubao, Feishu and Volcengine Into an AI Office Stack
item.description: At Feishu's 2026 conference, CEO Liang Rubo cast Doubao agents, Feishu collaboration and Volcengine models-and-compute as one enterprise stack, highlighting Feishu 8.0 Agent CLI endpoints rising from 247 to 767 and H1 ARR growth 2.5 times year earlier.

item.title: Shanghai AI Lab Releases Atria Dawn Preview, a 744B MoE Agentic Model
item.description: Shanghai Artificial Intelligence Laboratory open-sourced Atria Dawn Preview under MIT, a 744B MoE agentic model built on GLM-5.2 with 256K context, FP8 weights, and a leading AutomationBench score of 53.8 for long-horizon research and engineering agents.

item.title: Huawei Unveils 3D AI Data-Center Reference Architecture in Wuhu
item.description: At an AIDC field meeting in Wuhu, Huawei released what it calls the industry's first 3D data-center reference architecture—cooling, IT, power and rooftop backup stacked vertically—to support 100,000-plus-card clusters with about nine-month delivery and over 90% electromechanical prefabrication.

item.title: Oracle Patches 800+ Vulnerabilities in September 2026 Security Update
item.description: The security updates resolve over 800 vulnerabilities across 17 product families, including over 100 critical-severity flaws. The post Oracle Patches 800+ Vulnerabilities in September 2026 Security Update appeared first on SecurityWeek.
